Blippi becomes a scientist for the day! His adventure begins at Mighty Coders where he learns how to build and communicate with machines through coding even making an airplane model move. Afterwards he visits an imagination museum exploring concepts like gravity through jungle gyms and pendulum exhibits and discovers that even big block towers can fall!

The Oddbods have some new goals! After a sequence of annoying events, Jeff decides he's had enough and is moving out! The others rally together to convince him to stay. Then, Fuse and Slick are smitten with a female jogger who blows them both a kiss. The pair are determined to outshine one another to prove who the kiss was for. Finally, Zee enters a road endurance race to win a trophy that looks like a gigantic hot dog!

The Oddbods are dealing with some big problems! Bubbles accidentally brings back a cute little space alien, but it multiplies at an alarming rate and Oddsville is soon crawling with the creatures! Then, an experiment with Pogo's ice cream makes everyone who eats it weightless. Soon, they're all loving spinning around in the air, but it's not long before they find themselves drifting away! Plus, Fuse tries to get away from everyone by retreating to an island.

Join Blippi for some farm-to-table fruit fun as he learns how fruit gets from the farm to your belly! He visits an orchard to learn how apples go from the orchard, to the factory, to the grocery store. Then, he visits a cherry farm to find out how cherries get to the store! Finally, he takes a tour of a frozen raspberry factory, where he rides on the harvester and explores the freezing factory!

Blippi learns all about bowling in this episode featuring the great indoors. There's always fun to be had even when the weather doesn't cooperate and Blippi knows just how to find it! Blippi learns the proper way to roll a bowling ball and how to knock down the pins for a strike!

Get ready to get creative with colors and art with Meekah! First, Meekah's slime is in black and white! She searches the most colorful places to add color back to her gooey globs of slime. Can she find all the colors of the rainbow? Then, draw along with Meekah! She explores and plays on a real fire truck, learning about the different parts and noticing it has shapes and colors that she can draw to create her own firetruck!

Join Meekah for a land, sea and space extravaganza! First, she boards the Intrepid aircraft carrier for an air and sea adventure! She explores an airplane, a helicopter and learns about life as a sailor. Then, 3-2-1 Blast Off! Astronaut Meekah zooms around the Columbia Memorial Space Center. She builds a model of Apollo 11, watches a parachute sail to the ground, programs a Mars Rover and makes gooey slime for Blippi!

Blippi and Meekah are learning how to be firefighters! Their adventure starts with a tour of a New York City Fire Station, where they see old fire vehicles, ring the alarm bells and even try on firefighter uniforms. Then, Blippi visits the exciting city of Kidzania to continue his training. After learning about fire safety, he gets to ride in a firetruck and handle the hose to put out a simulated fire. It's an action-packed day of learning and fun!

What's cooking? Blippi is! He's visiting a cooking school to learn how to be a chef. He puts on his apron and learns how to follow a recipe to make a delicious and healthy meal. It's a fun and educational look at the art of cooking that will make you hungry for more.

Zak's greatest invention, the Shrinkinator, backfires, shrinking him and his grandpa down to the size of bugs! Their new bug-sized life immediately gets more complicated when their very first attempt to find the machine's missing parts leads them straight into a trap. Captured by the menacing mite Adilla, they must now outsmart their captor just to continue their quest to get back to normal.

The backyard is turned upside down! The Insectibles are baffled when they encounter Hye, a cockroach walking around without a head. As they investigate this spooky mystery, they face an even bigger problem: a gang of crooks disguised as the Insectibles is committing crimes and ruining their reputation. Now, the team must solve the riddle of the headless bug while hunting down their devious doppelgangers to clear their name.

The adventure begins with a daring rescue as Chowser and Willow save Zak from the clutches of the Ant Queen. But their relief is short-lived when Zak uncovers a sinister secret: the ants plan to make Chowser their next meal! Before they can even recover from that crisis, their quest home is dealt another blow when a giant magpie swoops down and snatches a vital Shrinkinator part. The team must now stage a high-flying heist to steal back their technology from the bird's massive nest.

It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

The Oddbods are dealing with some big changes! Pogo tries his new hypnosis machine on Jeff, who scoffs at it. But it's not long before Pogo gets Jeff to behave like a dog! Then, Zee and Jeff are forced to live together when Jeff calls fumigators on Zee's house. How long can this alliance of opposites last? Plus, when Newt goes on holiday, Zee is enlisted to house-sit and look after her beloved pet hamster!

The Oddbods are having a very busy day! Zee needs some money, so he does some odd jobs, but his laziness makes him a less-than-ideal employee. Then, after a near-accident, Bubbles creates a health serum to improve a cow's intelligence, but a guinea pig eats it instead and develops a super-brain! Finally, it's photo day, and Slick is determined to make sure he's front and center in the picture this year.

Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see Ali again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of Ali so that Ali's heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male Xiqi from the Taipei City Zoo and female Baby who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino Xiqi was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino Baby to raise the white rhino population.

p.t: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E03 - The Secret Lives of Pumas
p.d: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Pumas are also known by the names of cougar or mountain lion. However, these cats are only distantly related to lions. They're much more closely related to cheetahs. And while pumas are often found in mountains, they're just as at home in the lowlands, dense forests, treeless pampers, or deserts.

p.t: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E04 - The Secret Lives of Lions
p.d: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Lions differ from all other cats in that they are highly social, forming prides of up to 35 animals. There are now thought to be fewer than 15,000 lions remaining in Kenya's Masai Mara, a drop of 75% in 50 years.

p.t: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E06 - The Secret Lives of Jaguars
p.d: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. The first jaguar scientists struggled to go anywhere near their subjects. But times have changed. There are now a couple of places in the world where seeing a wild jaguar is a possibility rather than a dream.

p.t: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E07 - The Secret Lives of Cheetahs
p.d: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Cheetahs are not your standard big cats, they differ from the others in many ways. First, cheetahs are daytime hunters with eyesight optimized for open landscape and distant prey. Second, They're possibly the fastest land animals that have ever lived.

p.t: Survive the Wild - S01:E03 - Cunning Copulation
p.d: Finding a mate, building a nest, and raising kids are all part of the whole reproductive behavior thing. But it’s not as easy as it sounds. First, you’ve got to sift through lots of possible partners to find the one with the best genes to keep your family line going. Nesting involves finding some space and then guarding it fiercely, while raising the little ones takes loads of energy as you have to feed, teach, and keep them safe until they grow up. This episode dives into the ins and outs of how creatures go about their reproductive business.

p.t: Survive the Wild - S01:E04 - Battle Plans
p.d: Surviving in the wild often means being able to fight and win. This fighting strategy is called agonism and is used to set ranks, get resources, claim territory, and attract partners. There's no certainty in the wild, but animals that get good at agonism have a better shot at living to see another day.

p.t: Miracles of Nature - S02:E12 - Naturally Refreshing
p.d: Thailand is one of the few countries in south-east Asia that has never been a European colony. Perhaps the word thai which means free has something to do with it. It is possibly the reason why this country evokes a certain magic that sets it apart from the surrounding countries. From Thailand we travel to Sri Lanka.

p.t: Miracles of Nature - S02:E13 - The Best Of
p.d: Miracles of Nature has travelled to the four corners of the Earth - we look back over the astonishing range of destinations visited – each offering remarkable and stunning sights combined with dramatic histories and awe inspiring beauty.
